'''LF-R3D''' was a [[valet droid]] who served [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sargo VenHalgon]].

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], LF-R3D accompanied VenHalgon when the lord hired the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Twilight's Kiss]]'' from [[Cularin Star Tours]] and went on a vacation in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. VenHalgon landed the yacht on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and LF-3RD remained with the ship while VenHalgon and his party went on a hunting expedition. When they failed to return, LF-R3D alerted the [[Office of Peace and Security]] and activated an emergency signal aboard the ''Kiss''. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] came to the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] assistance and found VenHalgon. Afterwards, LF-R3D very grateful to the the heroes for their help.
